correctness.rationale: For arbitrary positive weights, arrowhead radial interlacing and class-difference eigenspaces yield leaf-pair spectral coefficients in the strict order +,-,+, including tied weights. Zero total mass and zero first moment give strict positive off-diagonal φ(L) for every strictly convex φ via the secant/tangent comparison. Hence each leaf-leaf exponential entry has negative initial slope, a zero at time zero, and a positive constant-mode limit. The generalized Descartes exponential rule limits all zeros to two counting multiplicities, forcing exactly one additional simple positive zero. Hub-leaf signs are +,-, so monotone eigenvalue multipliers make all hub-leaf kernel entries positive. Bernstein subordination gives α≤1 strict positivity and row sums one give the exact infinity-norm contractivity horizon. The numeric checker passed but is not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The new quantified assertion is a complete, one-simple-zero-per-leaf-pair sign classification for every strictly positive, independently weighted finite star under the continuous-time fractional heat family, with an extension to strictly convex increasing spectral multipliers. The closest accessible primary sources establish general early nonpositivity, ordinary/fractional subunit positivity, and unweighted complete multipartite cases, not the arbitrary-weight sign sequence or root count. Related weighted-star resolvent and rational one-step findings are not implications for the time-domain exponential. Searches did not identify an exact equivalent; priority uncertainty is retained.

value.rationale: The complete arbitrary-weight star time-sign classification upgrades qualitative eventual positivity to an exact single sign transition for each leaf pair, including all fractional powers above one and arbitrary increasing strictly convex spectral deformations. It gives a sharp maximum-norm contractivity restoration time on a natural heterogeneous branching diffusion network, not obtainable by a known full-star unweighted specialization or a resolvent bound alone.
